limitations: Derived from original engine MotionTable samples and stage.rs affine geometry, not captured hardware vertices.
MZX clears active slots after earlier quake/pivot setup and has no active shake/quake/SBAS/SOXY/haze/rule; async texture handoff remains timing-dependent.
Group0 current wait approximately motion local time1500..5500ms; group29 and preceding stage motions have unknown phase.
Preserve full original UV domain and source dimensions; screen projection is independent of physical texture resolution.
Pixel-centre affine inverse mapping and bilinear source-alpha support on CPU; not captured GXM raster coverage or real GPU timing.
Uses edge-clamped bilinear texture sampling and positive floating-point alpha support; hardware precision and triangle top-left boundaries can differ slightly.
Source-alpha ROI is not applicable to NoAlpha parents; MaskAlpha/Footprint require independent semantics checks.
16/32px meshes use exact decoded alpha, a conservative two-source-texel dilation, and original texture UV mapping. They have no measured speed or pixel-equivalence claim.
Independent layer26 uses an unknown motion phase, so its0..5000ms samples are a range, not simultaneous with group0 time.
Large-shader fusion must preserve per-layer bounds, blending order and UNORM8 pack/unpack semantics; union sizes do not establish actual gain.
Actual source envelope and pixels verified, but only script-derived sampled time points, not captured hardware vertices.
Both point and edge-clamped bilinear source sampling reported.
Q8 uses floor(clamp(alpha,0,255)+.5), matching group UNORM8 helper; native surface conversion rounding and interpolator precision are not independently GPU-tested.
NoAlpha is intentionally not applied: group mask is constructed before Pixel shade becomes NoAlpha.
Does not establish actual saved group alpha, final composite, target lifetime or all intermediate animation times.

recommendations: Prefer offline exact-alpha support meshes with original texture/UV, bounded merged geometry and per-draw semantic eligibility.
Evaluate limited equal-geometry layer35 PSNormal19 -> layer34 fixedMultiply fusion; preserve Q8 intermediate and original F16 output/fixed-blend boundary.
Do not blindly fuse the three op7 union quads: unconditional three-source union sampling increases source samples by about29..30% at selected phases.
Evaluate single-source virtual mask in final composite, preserving254 and F16->Q8; preserve persistent mask materialization/cache/fences.
Do not cull all previous stage/group draws based on parent0 geometric coverage: base texture mask retains254 in visible pixels.
No guaranteed FPS uplift follows from CPU coverage estimates or fewer API calls.
